verdict.rationale: Asaas documents its own hosted checkout, 'Asaas Checkout', where card data is entered on a page Asaas controls. It also documents a payment page where the payer picks among enabled payment methods, plus payment links, so developers can avoid building their own payment UI. The evidence is thin on how the redirect works and on any conversion optimization. missing for 10: documentation of the checkout redirect flow (checkout URL or session creation, return URLs), evidence of conversion-optimization features, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can redirect customers to a vendor-hosted, conversion-optimized checkout page without building my own payment UI

citations.quote: Asaas Checkout | The data is entered on a page controlled by Asaas
When billingType is UNDEFINED, the payer can choose among the payment methods enabled on the account when accessing the payment page.
Features such as subscriptions, payment links, split, receivables anticipation, subaccounts, invoices, and Webhooks are also available.
